segments.t: Inside German's zombie horror story, Max shows Senya and Fedya where Lyova bit his arm, right as an emergency news broadcast announces that a mysterious virus has locked down Moscow.
Он просто так никого не кусает.
Let's break down each line of the zombie outbreak in the kitchen.
'Imagine, Lyova just bit me.' Imagining Lyova just bit him is how Max lays out the situation for Fedya.
'An unknown infection has gripped the capital.' Since an unknown infection has gripped the capital, Max does not waste words on excuses.
'All exits out of Moscow are blocked.' Mentioning that all exits out of Moscow are blocked moves the talk in a new direction.
'They say the virus arrived from Thailand.' By saying the virus arrived, Max keeps his side of the story grounded.

'Tourists are always dragging all kinds of nasty stuff back!' Because tourists are always dragging all kinds of nasty stuff back, Senya does not bother softening the blow for Fedya. Russian puts the key word right up front so his emotion lands on the first beat.
'Back, do not come near us!' Insisting that back do not come near them shows Senya is not backing down.
'Lyova is a very well-mannered person.' Senya mentions that Lyova is a very well person so Fedya sees what is at stake.
Он просто так никого не кусает.
'He does not bite anyone for no reason.' Claiming that he does not bite anyone for no reason sounds confident, even if Fedya has doubts.
'That means you are already infected, Max!' Fedya insists that that means Max is already infected, leaving Max no room to argue.
'Guys, I was just joking!' Saying that he was just joking is how Max takes charge of the moment. Russian puts the key word right up front so his emotion lands on the first beat.

'What, did you really believe it?' Here wondering what Fedya really believe it shows Max looking for the real truth. Notice how he sticks to the formal "you", keeping a professional line between them.
'A strange guest out there ordered brains.' With the shift and news in play, Max keeps this short reply brisk and direct.

'Do we have any fresh brains?' Checking whether they have any fresh brains cuts straight through the tension between Max and Fedya. Russian expresses having something as "by me is", keeping the phrase short and grounded. Now listen to the whole zombie outbreak scene again at natural speed.
Он просто так никого не кусает.
Remember the super useful two-word phrase meaning 'for no reason' or 'just because' — literally 'simply so'. Until next time!
